purpose: Bind the active 001H work carrier to an exact current-main tree so the existing receipt-consuming v1 writer can selectively port evidence-backed Second Shift paths while preserving every unselected current-main path.

main_carrier_proof.meaning: Git tree object identity proves the complete recursive file/mode/subtree snapshot is identical even though commit ancestry differs.

selected_port_scope.overlap_rule: Each overlap must be reconciled against current-main semantics before its final blob is admitted; CORE-DELEGATIONS preserves current main live owner state.

existing_writer_validity.writer_base_tree_rule: The writer derives base_tree from the exact admitted work-ref predecessor.
existing_writer_validity.why_sufficient_now: The admitted predecessor tree equals the bound current-main tree, so full-content selected writes preserve every unselected current-main path by construction.

before_every_selected_port: re-resolve current main ref and tree
re-resolve exact active carrier predecessor tree
require current main tree SHA to equal the bound carrier baseline tree SHA unless an explicit researched reconciliation updates the baseline
require active-work branch_or_ref and subject to match the exact carrier predecessor
main_movement_fence.if_main_tree_moves: STOP. Do not transfer carrier equivalence. Reconcile to the new current-main tree through a new governed main-byte-identical carrier or another explicitly proven preservation mechanism before continuing executable porting.

execution_order: Preserve this record and the historical reconciliation manifest as planning/evidence artifacts.
Port candidate-only files in bounded exact-CAS groups sized for native issue ingress; rebind active authority after each successful carrier commit before the next write.
Reconcile the eight overlap paths against then-current main, preserving main semantics and adding only evidence-backed Second Shift behavior.
After the full selected port, prove every unselected path remains byte-identical to the bound current-main baseline and that no stale historical-only path was imported.
Run current enforcement on the exact reconciled SHA, then fresh hosted and A-01 qualification where host dependent.
Satisfy Mastery activation, nine-lane live proof, morning telemetry/evaluator/drift proof, explicit promotion and terminal freeze before 001H receipt.

research_basis.supports: Trees and blobs are content-addressed; identical tree SHA names mean recursively identical tree contents.
Git is a content-addressable filesystem and tree objects represent directory/file snapshots.
Create-tree overlays supplied entries on a base_tree, preserving unselected entries.
Production writer derives base_tree from admitted predecessor and updates ref with force=false.
001H current authority is the main-byte-identical carrier ref/subject.
